Review the applicable agreement before starting a paid service.

Obtain permission before republishing branded material or using it in a way that suggests an endorsement. Third-party assets remain subject to their respective licences.

This website links to the RoboRingo application and third-party services such as demo scheduling and translation. Review the terms presented by those services when you use them.

Questions and applicable agreements

Contact sales@roboringo.com with questions about these website terms. These draft website terms require the operating company’s legal review, including confirmation of its legal identity, applicable law, and any limitation or dispute provisions before publication.
